turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you explain what SUM does and how IF works?

turns.speaker: candidate

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me about formatting cells and number formats.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: You format cells to make them look nice. You can use currency and percentage and date formats. Formatting changes how things look.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is a table in Excel, and how is filtering different from sorting?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: A table is data in Excel. Filtering is different from sorting because they do different things. Sorting sorts and filtering filters.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you make a chart?

turns.speaker: candidate
